notes.title: UPDATE #1 - april/2017
notes.notes:
[h1] Extinction of the stamina bar [/h1]
We think to sprint without the stamina bar limitation makes the matches more competitive.

[h1] Extinction of the Respawn screen [/h1]
It makes the return to the match quicker after dying.

[h1] Control Points Bar Bug in Conquer Mode Resolved [/h1]
When you played a match in Conquest Mode and you took a Control Point there was a bug that you could not see the stuffing bar.

[h1] Error in saving scores by players solved [/h1]
At the end of each winning match the winning team players scored points but were not saved so that they could continue adding and raising patents

[h1] Map Lighting Improved in Base Militar [/h1]
When playing the Lethal Weapon mode, the room where the generators were very dark

[h1] Error in double message of death inside base solved [/h1]
When a player died on the enemy base, two lines with the same information

[h1] Generators loading bar error resolved [/h1]
At the end of each round in Lethal Weapon mode the loading bar of the generators returned half full when it was to zero.

[h1] Improved Lethal Weapon Mode display [/h1]
The scoreboard design of this game mode has been improved to be more comfortable for the quick views during the rush of the match.
